name: MonoGrain
description: Granulates a real-time mono input. Spawns overlapping grains of length `winsize` at the rate `grainrate`, with optional per-grain randomisation of window length. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: grainrate
inputs.description: Rate of new grain creation in Hz

inputs.name: winrandpct
inputs.description: Per-grain window-size randomness as a fraction of winsize (0..1)

name: MonoGrainBF
description: Granulates a real-time mono input and pans each grain into a first-order B-format (W, X, Y, Z) field. Per-grain azimuth/elevation can be randomised independently. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: grainrate
inputs.description: Rate of new grain creation in Hz

inputs.name: winrandpct
inputs.description: Per-grain window-size randomness as a fraction of winsize

inputs.name: azrand
inputs.description: Per-grain azimuth deviation, fraction of azimuth

inputs.name: elrand
inputs.description: Per-grain elevation deviation, fraction of elevation

name: SinGrain
description: Granular synthesis of sinusoidal grains using the built-in Hanning-style envelope. Each trigger spawns a grain of length `dur` at frequency `freq`. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: kr or ar trigger; non-positive to positive transition spawns a grain

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Grain duration in seconds (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Sine frequency in Hz (polled at grain creation)

name: SinGrainB
description: Granular synthesis of sinusoidal grains using a user-supplied envelope buffer. Each trigger spawns a grain of length `dur` at `freq` shaped by `envbuf`. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: kr or ar trigger; non-positive to positive transition spawns a grain

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Grain duration in seconds (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Sine frequency in Hz (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: envbuf
inputs.description: Buffer holding the grain envelope shape

name: SinGrainI
description: Granular synthesis of sinusoidal grains using two user-supplied envelope buffers, interpolated by `ifac`. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: kr or ar trigger; non-positive to positive transition spawns a grain

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Grain duration in seconds (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Sine frequency in Hz (polled at grain creation)

name: SinGrainBF
description: SinGrain with first-order B-format Ambisonic panning per grain. Outputs W, X, Y, Z channels. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: kr or ar trigger; non-positive to positive transition spawns a grain

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Grain duration in seconds (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Sine frequency in Hz (polled at grain creation)

inputs.name: wComp
inputs.description: If non-zero, compensate W channel by 1/sqrt(2)

name: GrainSinJ
description: Josh Parmenter's variant of GrainSin: multi-channel sinusoidal granulator with per-grain panning, an optional user envelope buffer, and configurable maxGrains. From sc3-plugins JoshUGens.

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: kr or ar trigger; non-positive to positive transition spawns a grain

inputs.name: pan
inputs.description: Pan position; for stereo (-1..1), for >2 channels uses PanAz

inputs.name: envbufnum
inputs.description: Envelope buffer number; -1 uses the built-in Hanning envelope

inputs.name: maxGrains
inputs.description: Maximum simultaneously active grains (allocated at init)
